  | tips                     = Official description is wrong. This rod does not remove Madstone rage. What it does: Clears any and all tiers of the [[Stormreaver]]s Charge, this includes both deleterious (negative) and positive effects of the charge. So you will lose the spell point regeneration, health bonus, knockdown immunity, etc. It also removes the new madstone attraction de-buff. Due to this it's generally not worth using. Since if your character is too weak to survive the negative effects of the charges, you should simply stay away from the [[Stormreaver]] and easily avoid them in the first place.
